name: 2026 Honda Odyssey
nri_take: Don't let anyone shame you for driving a minivan — it's the ultimate family vehicle. Magic Slide seats, built-in vacuum, cabin talk intercom. Fits 8 people AND the suitcases for the India trip. Every desi family secretly wants one.
pros: Magic Slide 2nd row seats are genius

name: 2026 Mercedes-Benz GLC
nri_take: The entry point to the three-pointed star. Compact enough for Bay Area parking, prestigious enough for the community wedding arrival. MBUX infotainment is genuinely impressive. The GLC says 'I've made it' without screaming it.
pros: Strong resale for a luxury car
cons: Rear seat tighter than non-luxury SUVs

name: 2026 Toyota Camry
nri_take: The OG desi car in America. Every Indian family's first car was a Camry, and the 2026 is all-hybrid with 50+ MPG. Bulletproof reliability means you'll spend zero time at the mechanic. Resale value is practically a savings account.
cons: No more non-hybrid option (some prefer it)

name: 2026 Toyota RAV4 Hybrid
nri_take: The default desi family car — and for good reason. Insane fuel economy, Toyota reliability that lasts 200K+ miles, and resale value that makes your CA proud. Perfect for the daily tech campus commute and weekend Costco runs.
pros: Best-in-class fuel economy for an SUV
Spacious rear seat for 3 car seats
cons: Can feel underpowered on highway merges
Popular = hard to find at MSRP

name: 2026 Honda Civic
nri_take: The most-Googled car in America, and for good reason. Perfect first car for new H-1B arrivals — affordable, reliable, great on gas. Also doubles as the college-going kid's car when they turn 16.
pros: Most refined interior in its class

name: 2026 Honda CR-V Hybrid
nri_take: The RAV4's biggest rival and arguably the more refined choice. Interior quality punches above its class — feels like a mini Accord inside. Every desi neighborhood has at least three of these on every street.
cons: FWD base is less desirable than RAV4's standard AWD

name: 2026 Mercedes-Benz GLE
nri_take: The doctor's car — this is what half the Indian physician community drives. Spacious, comfortable, and carries serious road presence. The optional 3rd row makes it a luxury people-mover for when the extended family visits.
pros: Air suspension option for supreme comfort

name: 2026 Toyota Sienna
nri_take: The ONLY hybrid minivan in America — 36 MPG combined is unheard of for something this big. Standard AWD too. If fuel costs matter (and for desis, they always do), this is the logical choice over the Odyssey.
cons: Interior not as premium as Odyssey

name: 2026 Honda Accord
nri_take: The Camry's sportier rival. Better to drive, slightly more upscale interior. The hybrid gets 50+ MPG city — commute from Fremont to SF on a tablespoon of gas. Serious car for the practical professional.
pros: Hybrid matches Camry on fuel economy
cons: Slightly pricier than Camry at comparable trims

name: 2026 Hyundai Tucson Hybrid
nri_take: The value play that doesn't feel like a compromise. More features per dollar than Toyota or Honda, with a design that actually turns heads in the apartment parking lot. The 10-year warranty is peace of mind your parents would approve of.
pros: Excellent value — loaded with features for the price
More cargo space than RAV4 or CR-V
cons: Resale not as strong as Toyota/Honda
Engine can drone under hard acceleration

name: 2026 Kia Carnival
nri_take: Looks like an SUV, drives like a minivan — the stealth family hauler. If you want minivan space without the minivan look, the Carnival's boxy design fools everyone. VIP Lounge seats in the top trim rival first-class airline seats.
pros: Most cargo space of any minivan
cons: V6 can feel underpowered when loaded
Third-row access not as easy as sliding doors suggest

name: 2026 Mercedes-Benz GLS
nri_take: The S-Class of SUVs. If you want the ultimate luxury 3-row and budget isn't a constraint, this is the pinnacle. Airport pickups in this feel like a private car service. Maybach version exists for the truly balling.
cons: Size is challenging in tight spots

name: 2026 Hyundai Sonata
nri_take: Gorgeous design that looks like a $50K car. The hybrid is seriously efficient and comes loaded with tech. If you want something that stands out in the parking lot without the luxury price tag, this is your sedan.
cons: Resale not as strong as Toyota/Honda
Some engine recalls in past years
Brand stigma persists for some buyers

name: 2026 Kia Sportage Hybrid
nri_take: Kia's glow-up is real — this looks like a $50K car but costs $35K. Largest cargo space in its class means you can actually fit all the luggage for the India trip. Dual screens and ventilated seats come standard where Toyota charges extra.
pros: Best MPG in the compact SUV class

name: 2026 Mercedes-Benz C-Class
nri_take: The entry luxury sedan that punches way above its weight. Interior borrowed from the S-Class with that massive portrait screen. Perfect for the young professional who wants Mercedes without the $80K commitment.
cons: Options list is long and pricey

name: 2026 Mercedes-Benz E-Class
nri_take: The Goldilocks Mercedes — not too small, not too flashy, absolutely perfect. The kind of car successful desi professionals aspire to. Rear seat space is actually usable for adults. Mild hybrid adds efficiency without compromising performance.
cons: Base engine is adequate, not exciting

name: 2026 Tesla Model 3
nri_take: The #1 car among Asian American buyers. If you're in tech, this is practically the company car. Zero gas + home charging = ₹0 fuel bill. The Highland refresh brought a much-needed interior upgrade.
pros: Fastest acceleration in its price range

name: 2026 Toyota Highlander Hybrid
nri_take: When the in-laws visit from India and you need 3 rows — this is it. The hybrid gets minivan-like MPG in an SUV body. Toyota reliability means you'll hand this down to the kids. Temple run approved for 8.
pros: Excellent hybrid fuel economy for a 3-row
cons: Cargo space behind 3rd row is tiny

name: 2026 BMW X3
nri_take: The sportiest compact luxury SUV you can buy. If you actually enjoy driving (not just commuting), the X3 makes every trip fun. The new generation brought a massive interior upgrade. GLC's biggest rival for the desi buyer.
cons: Rear seat not as roomy as GLC

name: 2026 Hyundai Palisade
nri_take: The family hauler that actually feels luxurious. Second-row captain's chairs = no more fighting between the kids. Looks and feels like a $60K luxury SUV at $40K. When the parents visit, they ride in comfort.
pros: U.S. News #1 Best 3-Row SUV for Families
cons: V6 can feel strained when fully loaded

name: 2026 BMW X5
nri_take: The 'driving enthusiast who needs an SUV' car. More engaging to drive than the GLE but still comfortable enough for long road trips. Popular among desi professionals in their 40s who've graduated from the X3.
pros: Engaging to drive for an SUV

name: 2026 Kia Telluride
nri_take: The Palisade's twin — built on the same platform but with a more rugged, boxy look. Slightly more cargo space. If you want the 3-row SUV life but don't want to match every other Palisade in your apartment complex.
pros: More cargo than Palisade behind 3rd row
cons: Interior not quite as upscale as Palisade

name: 2026 BMW X7
nri_take: BMW's answer to the GLS. The 3-row luxury SUV for those who want the BMW driving experience in a family-size package. That massive kidney grille is love-it-or-hate-it. Rear passengers get theater-screen entertainment.

name: 2026 Subaru Outback
nri_take: The Pacific Northwest desi special — if you live near Seattle, Portland, or anywhere it snows, the Outback's standard AWD and ground clearance are hard to beat. Not flashy, but absolutely dependable.
pros: Good ground clearance for light off-road
cons: Fuel economy average for its class

name: 2026 BMW 3 Series
nri_take: The benchmark sport sedan — if you want a luxury car that's genuinely fun to drive, not just comfortable. Popular first luxury car for desi tech workers in their late 20s. The xDrive AWD handles snow states well.
cons: Base model lacks some expected features

name: 2026 Toyota Grand Highlander Hybrid
nri_take: The Highlander's big brother — stretched wheelbase means the 3rd row is actually usable by adults. When auntie and uncle visit from India and you need real 3-row space with Toyota fuel economy, this is the answer.
cons: Interior not as luxurious as price suggests
New model — limited real-world reliability data

name: 2026 BMW 5 Series
nri_take: The E-Class fighter that's more driver-focused. Massive theater screen in the rear (optional) entertains kids on long drives. If you prefer driving engagement over pure comfort, this is your luxury sedan.
cons: Rear theater screen is pricey extra

name: 2026 Tesla Model Y
nri_take: The #1 selling car in California — and in every tech company parking lot. Zero gas costs, insane acceleration, and the tech factor. If you work in FAANG, half your team drives one. Supercharger network means road trips are easy.
pros: Zero fuel costs — charge at home
Supercharger network is best in class
cons: Insurance costs higher than gas SUVs

name: 2026 Lexus RX
nri_take: Toyota luxury — all the reliability with none of the repair bills. The RX hybrid gets 35+ MPG combined which is insane for a luxury SUV. If you want Mercedes prestige but Toyota ownership costs, this is the sweet spot.
pros: Lower maintenance costs than German rivals
cons: Not as engaging to drive as BMW

name: 2026 Lexus NX
nri_take: The 'sensible luxury' choice. Gets 40+ MPG, Lexus reliability, and starts under $44K — the most affordable way into genuine luxury. Perfect for the pragmatic professional who wants nice things without overspending.

name: 2026 Lexus ES
nri_take: The Camry's luxury twin — based on the same platform but with Lexus refinement. 44 MPG highway in a luxury sedan is remarkable. If you love the Camry but want to treat yourself, this is the natural upgrade path.

name: 2026 Lexus GX
nri_take: The rugged Lexus — body-on-frame like a Land Cruiser but with luxury trimmings. 3rd row + Lexus reliability + genuine off-road capability. Great for families who do Yellowstone/national park road trips AND want to look good at temple.

name: 2026 Audi Q5
nri_take: The tech-forward luxury SUV. Virtual cockpit, quattro AWD, and understated styling that whispers rather than shouts. Popular among Bay Area desi professionals who find BMW too flashy and Mercedes too common.

name: 2026 Audi Q7
nri_take: Audi's 3-row option for the family. Shares DNA with the Porsche Cayenne but costs significantly less. Quattro AWD handles any weather. If you want understated German luxury with 3 rows, the Q7 delivers.
cons: Cargo space limited with 3rd row up

name: 2026 Genesis GV70
nri_take: The smartest luxury buy right now. You get $60K worth of car for $45K — same features that cost $10K extra on a BMW/Mercedes come standard here. The desi value-seeker's dream luxury car. 10-year warranty seals the deal.

name: 2026 Genesis GV80
nri_take: Genesis's 3-row flagship that directly challenges the GLE and X5 at $15K less. Available 3rd row, gorgeous interior, and that 10-year warranty. If you don't need the badge, this is objectively the better buy.

name: 2026 Acura MDX
nri_take: Honda luxury with 3 rows — the practical choice for families who want reliability above all else. Lower ownership costs than German rivals. The Type S with 355 HP is surprisingly fun. Underrated in the desi community.
cons: Interior materials good but not great
SH-AWD complex and pricey to repair

name: 2026 Range Rover Sport
nri_take: The ultimate status SUV in the desi community — nothing turns heads at a shaadi like a Range Rover pulling up. Stunning design, commanding presence, and the feeling of having truly arrived. Just budget for the maintenance.
cons: Maintenance and repair costs are very high

name: 2026 Porsche Cayenne
nri_take: The SUV that drives like a sports car — literally shares DNA with the 911. For the successful founder or senior VP who wants performance AND practicality. The Porsche badge carries weight everywhere in the world.

name: 2026 Porsche Macan
nri_take: Porsche goes all-electric with the new Macan — and it's spectacular. If you want a compact luxury SUV that's quicker than most sports cars, this is it. The tech-founder crowd is trading Tesla Model Y for these.
cons: Charging network not as good as Tesla
